res.title: Forbidden
res.html:
403 Forbidden

nginx

The admin pages of mattbox answer on its own network only. Tunnel traffic reaches nginx from 127.0.0.1, and the lanOnly guard denies loopback on purpose, so nobody on the internet reaches the admin UI. Use /nextcloud from outside, or open http://mattbox.local/ from home.
